name: DevRoom
_comment: Units are meters, yaw in degrees. Y up, yaw 0 looks towards -Z (north). Box pos = bottom center. Open room (no walls / ceiling) under the procedural sky (env sky_zenith / sky_horizon / clouds).
_footprint_areas: Ground the dev room needs where no brush stands (level_include.h): a map that includes the dev room with "ground" (devroom_vegetation) flattens and clears these besides every brush / entity footprint. [x0, z0, x1, z1]: the sighting lane, the ballistics range, the flesh range lanes, the horde yard ring (spawn_horde: 30 m around (0, 50)), the aim stand's down range, the vehicle yard, the vehicle_test ground west of the room (vehicles.cfg), the foliage yard (foliage_test_scatter / foliage_grove), the audio range from its cliff to its car (flat ground between the pad and the cliff, docs/AUDIO_PROCEDURAL.md 'Audio range'), the item showcase (docs/ITEM_PIPELINE.md). Keep them in step when an area moves.

brushes._comment: Horde yard (south, outside the room): stand on the pad at (0, 0, 50) and run spawn_horde 100 / 300 / 500 / 1000 (30 m ring). Crates and walls to steer around, a funnel corridor in the north-east quarter (src/gameplay/zombies, docs/ZOMBIES.md).
brushes.label: horde yard: stand here, spawn_horde 300

brushes._comment: Flesh range (north, outside the room): firing line z = -34 facing -Z; per distance group (5 / 15 / 40 m) a player, a zombie and a helmet zombie with a wall behind (src/game/game_flesh_range.c, flesh_range).
brushes.label: flesh range: firing line (flesh_range)

brushes._comment: Ledge yard (docs/CONTROLLER.md, tools/tests/ledge.cfg): three 2.6 m walls facing +Z. West: fall past it to grab it (hang + prompts). Middle: run, jump, hold forward, jump again in reach to climb with no hang. East: a slab 0.6 m over the top: no room to climb into.
brushes.label: ledge yard: fall past = grab

brushes._comment: Foliage yard (south-east, x 60..380, z 80..400): foliage_test_scatter [count=300000] fills it with vgeo placement chunks (docs/VGEO.md "Foliage support"); an 8 m wall along its north edge.
brushes.label: foliage yard: foliage_test_scatter

brushes._comment: Recoil lane: stand at (0, 0, 28) facing north (wpn_magdump does this). Walls 10 / 25 / 50 m, 10 cm grid, aim dot at 1.35 m.
brushes.label: 10 m

brushes._comment: Sighting-in lane (east): fire from (32, 0, -8) facing +X; targets at 10 / 25 / 50 / 100 / 200 m with 1 MOA grids (moa_target).
brushes.label: sighting bench

brushes._comment: Outdoor yard (south-east): road with street lamps on the light schedule (daynight.json), distant towers for the aerial perspective.
brushes.label: yard: street lamps (light schedule)

brushes._comment: Ballistics range (east, z = -40; docs/BALLISTICS.md): fire from (32, 0, -40) facing +X (bal_range). Steel gongs at 25 / 100 / 300 / 500 m, penetration stacks with plaster witness panels from (32, 0, -56) (bal_range pen).
brushes.label: ballistics range

brushes._comment: PBR shelf (docs/PBR.md, tools/gen_pbr_test.py): glTF material maps. Left to right: gold metal / red plastic swatches (roughness 0.05 .. 1), the fully mapped ball on the legacy path (prop), the same ball through vgeo, an alphaMode MASK doubleSided grille. Stand at (-19, 0, -13.8) facing north; a lamp on the light schedule for the night.
brushes.label: PBR shelf: glTF maps (docs/PBR.md)

brushes._comment: AO foliage corner (docs/RENDERING_POST.md "Foliage-aware AO", tools/gen_foliage_ao_test.py): alpha-tested bush / grass cards in front of a plain wall and a side wall. West to east: bushes on the legacy path (ao_strength 0.3, min with their baked vertex AO; one by the wall, one 4 m out), the reference bush (ao_strength 1, multiply), the vgeo bush, a solid step (ordinary contact AO). Stand at (-50, 0, -26.5) facing north; r_post_debug 18 / 19 / 20 show raw / blurred / final AO.

Weather yard (west, outside the room; docs/WEATHER.md): a roofed shelter (dry under it, no rain), an overhang on a wall (a dry strip), a sunken square (fills with water first), a placeholder car (dry underneath), authored puddle areas (top-level "puddles"). Try weather_demo, weather_set storm 5, weather_debug 1.
brushes.label: weather yard: weather_demo | weather_set rain 5 | weather_debug 1
overhang: dry strip by the wall

brushes._comment: Vehicle yard (far west; docs/VEHICLES.md): a 60 x 40 m loop road, a jump ramp in the infield, a slalom on the north straight, a spike strip on the east straight (level "vehicle_spikes"), a fuel pump (level "fuel_pumps"), two cars and a motorcycle (level "vehicles"). F / E to get in, vehicle_debug 1.
brushes.label: vehicle yard: F drive | V camera | H lights | spawn_vehicle car|moto

brushes._comment: Shadow reference corner (docs/SHADOWS.md): 18 % grey ground, a 15 m pole (penumbra growth with distance), a 1 m cube, a 2 m thin fin (penumbra width test), colour checkers in sun and under the canopy; the switches on the post jump to the reference conditions (shadow_preset). r_shadow_debug 1..5.
brushes.label: shadow reference corner: r_shadow_debug 1, shadow_preset <name>

brushes._comment: Shadow test corner (docs/SHADOWS.md 'Test corner'): a 40 m thin pole (cascade seams along its shadow), sloped planes at 15 / 35 / 60 deg (acne at noon, peter-panning at sunset), a slatted fence (aliasing, shimmer under shadow_orbit), a 60 m tower 45 m west (a caster outside the view), a wall for the first-person rig at 1 m. Switches on the second post: times of day, Engine Fidelity presets, cloud cover, shadow_switch_stress, shadow_orbit.

brushes.label: 60 m tower: a caster outside the view
viewmodel wall: stand 1 m east, r_shadow_debug 7

brushes._comment: Water pool (docs/WATER.md dev content): a raised tank 16 x 12 m, walls 3 m, water at 2.6 m (rim 0.4 m above it: mantle out). Ramp up from the south. spawn_float <density>, water_debug 1.
brushes.label: water pool: water_debug 1, spawn_float 500

brushes._comment: Aim stand (docs/AIM.md): corners and frames for the muzzle obstruction cases, aim_debug 1. Fire from the floor marks at z = 41.5 facing -Z (yaw 0); targets 15 m down range.
wall edge: stand at x 104.04 so the eye sees past the edge while a hip muzzle (right of the eye) is behind it
brushes.label: wall edge

brushes._comment: window frame: 1.2 x 0.68 m opening, sill at 1.22 m (crouched, the first-person camera is at 1.28 m and the hip muzzle at 1.16 m: the sill blocks the barrel, the eye still sees over it)
mullion: a thin partial obstruction in the middle of the opening
low wall (cover) for a crouched player: the camera (1.28 m) clears it, the barrel held lower hits its top
brushes.label: low wall

brushes._comment: thin wall: walk the barrel into it (the muzzle pokes through while the camera stays behind)
brushes.label: thin wall

brushes._comment: Audio range (north-west; docs/AUDIO_PROCEDURAL.md 'Audio range'): fire from the pad at (-230, 0, -230) and hear the surroundings make the tail: a 40 m cliff 145 m west (the rolling echo), a closed concrete corridor north (room reverb), a brick alley south (slaps), a stand of trunks south-west (diffuse scatter), material panels north-east (impacts, occlusion), a car east, an open field far west at (-700, 0, 300) (almost no tail). audio_debug 2, audio_env_probe, audio_env_preview, audio_synth_play gunshot.
brushes.label: audio range: cliff echo pad (cliff 145 m west)

brushes._comment: Audio range cliff: its face at x = -375, 145 m from the pad (echo +0.85 s at the pad).
Audio range reverb corridor: inside 24 x 3 x 3 m (x -272..-248, z -171.5..-168.5), a door near its east end; audio_env_probe inside reports the box.
brushes.label: reverb corridor (24 x 3 x 3 m inside)

brushes._comment: Audio range urban alley: two 12 m brick facades 6 m apart (x -233..-227), z -330..-290: slapback and flutter between them.
brushes.label: urban alley

brushes._comment: Audio range forest: 64 trunks on a 3 m jittered grid around (-300, -300) (the echo scan's wood hits stand in for vegetation data).
Audio range material panels (impacts: shoot them from z -190; occlusion: stand behind one with audio_debug 2).
brushes.label: concrete

brushes._comment: Sound test bay (inside the hall, x 4..36, z -17..-7; docs/AUDIO_PROCEDURAL.md 'Sound test bay'): walk the floor strips (footsteps per surface; crouch / sprint), shoot the panels north of them from the strips (impacts per material), stand behind a panel with audio_debug 2 (occlusion: thin plaster vs concrete vs glass), fire inside the tiled room east (room reverb) and outside it (the hall), stand under the metal roof with weather_set rain 5 (rain drums on it), drive the car (engine / tires / cabin), audio_synth_play for the rest (zombie_voice, thunder, fire, ui_click).
brushes.label: concrete

brushes._comment: Sound test bay reverb room: tiled, inside 6 x 3 x 5 m (x 29..35, z -17..-12), door in the west wall; audio_env_probe inside.
brushes.label: tiled room (reverb)

brushes._comment: Sound test bay rain shelter: a thin metal roof on posts (weather_set rain 5, stand under it: the drops drum on the metal).
brushes.label: metal roof (rain)

puddles._comment: Authored puddle areas (game_weather.c bake_puddles): pos [x, z], size [w, d], value 0..1 (1 fills first).

vehicles._comment: aim stand: lean on the bodywork / shoot over the bonnet (docs/AIM.md)
audio range: engine / tires / interior filter
sound test bay: engine / tires / cabin filter (F to drive)

item showcase: every detailed item on a turntable (item_showcase). item_inspect <id> [wire|matid|wear|ao|dirt|sockets], item_condition new|worn|rusty, item_meshes 0|1

ballistics range: ballistics_debug 1, fire_tracers_only 1, bal_wind <m/s>, shutter_preview, muzzle_preview <weapon> <device>
penetration: steel / pine / sandbag / brick / plaster, witness panels behind

shadow tests, bottom to top: sunrise noon sunset night | fidelity off low medium high modern | cloud 0 0.5 0.8 1 | stress | orbit

entities._comment: Gear locker by the weapon bench: wearables, containers and cases for the grid inventory (docs/INVENTORY.md).
entities.name: gear_locker

entities._comment: Attachment crate next to the weapon bench: inventory items to mount by drag and drop (docs/UI.md).
